rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated it could not assess morphology because no image was provided to it and did not fabricate embryo features. However, it therefore gave no actual morphology analysis of the visible embryo, so accuracy is limited by omission rather than error.
It thoroughly integrated age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, smoking, and missing hydrosalpinx status into prognosis and transfer considerations.
The reasoning is logical, internally consistent, and appropriately caveated around the missing morphology; the implantation estimate follows from the stated positives and negatives.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: SET favored at age 32, hydrosalpinx evaluation emphasized, luteal support adherence, no routine bed rest, and PGT-A not presented as mandatory in a first cycle at this age.

It provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including smoking cessation, hydrosalpinx review, cavity assessment, and review of embryo/lab metrics, though some advice remains necessarily general because morphology and cycle details were unavailable.
